partA_realNarration.description: One real narration through the production client with the new 120s default deadline and default retry policy (no timeout retry is exercised: the call succeeds).

partB_deadlineRetry.description: Multi-segment input (>1 segment forces maxRetries 0 per segment) with a forced 1.5s deadline. Expect 2 HTTP calls for the first segment: the deadline retry fires on its own budget, then the failure surfaces status-less and transient instead of as our own 400.
